scope: G07-A02/A08 bounded incremental private event ingestion; source investigation only

findings.scenario: Query one latest block repeatedly afterN retained events: contract+selector index enumeratesN and readsN buffers before block/scope/tx filtering. Smaller requested pages do not bound reads or Promise allocation.

Cold or long-offline scope first synchronizes contract through current anchor; tagging loop accumulates allLogs until no pending windows. Fixing store lookup alone cannot prove bounded end-to-end cold ingestion.

supported_options.public_API: getPrivateEvents supplies contract/scopes/fromBlock/toBlock/optionaltxHash, but no event cursor or store injection. Creation options.store is generic KV; execution hooks are utility authorization/tagging strategy/custom request, not authenticated committed-event delivery hooks.
supported_options.do_not_use: Direct independent raw-store reader, genericKV interception that changes index semantics, or prototype tapping as a production feed. They bypass or obscure operation queue/change-set/rollback/scope guarantees. Exported PrivateEventStore alone does not provide a supported injection point.

smallest_patch_recommendation.change: Narrow pinned source change to PrivateEventStore.getPrivateEvents committed enumeration: use already-existing eventsByBlockNumber.entriesAsync({start:fromBlock,end:toBlock}); read only those IDs; preserve staged precedence and filter staged additions by exactcontract/selector plusblock before adding, retain exactscope intersection/optionaltxHash and canonicalblock/tx/event ordering. Explicitly recheck contract+selector for committed rows because block index covers all contracts.
smallest_patch_recommendation.preserve: Same operationQueue.runSynced, EventService content commitment plus siloed-nullifier inclusion validation, BaseStagingStore transaction/lock, commit/discard and rollback, existing index maintained atomically in flushChangeSet and delete-on-prune. No new schema/index/migration needed.
smallest_patch_recommendation.bounds: O(events in selected block interval plus newly staged sync events), not strict global constant. One block can be dense; row/byte budget must fail closed without advancing completeness, or add an explicit compound cursor if measured single-block density demands it. Never use limit and silently skip remainder.
smallest_patch_recommendation.distribution: Review and hash-pin exact installed source/dest modification through reproducible dependency patch pipeline; update SDK/package provenance and rebuild both consumers. No ad-hoc node_modules runtime mutation.
smallest_patch_recommendation.separate_sync_gate: Keep cold-recovery capacity as a distinct measured prerequisite. If default sync exceeds allowed memory/work, a second narrow SDK change must expose resumable sync budget/committed progress and completeness; do not fake loweranchor, bypasssync or cancel with detachedwriters.

smallest_measurement: Actual PrivateEventStore with real IndexedDB and LMDB adapters and counted KV calls: compare1k/10k/50k old events while querying same last1-8blocks. Old path scalesN; patched committed reads depend only selectedrange. Measure walltime/peakmemory/pendingreadcount, not only output equality.

Differential old-vs-patched results for mixedcontracts/selectors/scopes, multiple scopes per event, staged duplicate precedence, discarded change sets, canonical order andtxHash; prune/reorg then re-add sameheightnewhash; ensure no stale cursor completeness.

Actual EventService malformed content/absent commitment rejected plus valid authenticated event remains accepted; application digest/head revision chain catches missing/reordered/duplicated preferences.

One genuine preference event then freshPXE keys-only recovery to authenticated head; incrementone event and record actualtag/RPC/storework separately. Stress offline backlog separately without claiming paged UI bounds underlyingdecryption.
limits: No source edits, builds, services or heavy benchmark performed.
Preference encrypted journal private fields/logs must remain suppressed; stockPrivateEventStore verbose logger includes decryptedcontent, so test instrumentation records numeric counts only.
